answer: A concrete sybil defense is throughput metering keyed to attestation depth. Every new identity starts adrift in an ocean of unproven peers earning almost nothing; only sustained honest participation raises its earning cap, like a zephyr slowly filling a sail. An attacker spawning M fake atlas nodes pays infrastructure cost M times, yet combined revenue stays pinned near one proven node's, since per-identity yield scales with accumulated attestations, not count. Flooding becomes a losing trade - linear cost, flat return - while honest agents compound.
